newsitem.title: JAPAN: General Motors unit mulling samurais -- underwriters.
newsitem.headline: General Motors unit mulling samurais -- underwriters.

text.p: General Motors Acceptance Corp (GMAC) is considering launching samurai bonds in two tranches, possibly by early December, underwriters said on Wednesday.
GMAC is wholly owned by General Motors Corp.

The sources said GMAC may be considering one tranche of yen/Australian dollar dual-currency samurais for Japanese retail investors and another of plain samurai bonds targeted at institutional investors. They said the amount and duration of the possible issues were still unknown, but that market rumours said the dual-currency issue was expected to be about 30 billion yen and the plain samurais about 20 billion yen
Underwriters said they would get clearer details after a scheduled meeting on Thursday between securities firms, GMAC, and a lead manager, which is a U.S. securities firm.
GMAC is the financing arm of General Motors.
